blocks.text: GENEVA, Switzerland — The Philippine government and a World Trade Organization (WTO)-backed global initiative are developing a cooperation framework to channel private-sector investments into least developed countries (LDCs). In August, the Philippine Mission to the WTO met with the Enhanced Integrated Framework (EIF) Secretariat to explore practical awareness-raising activities in Geneva and across the ASEAN region, as well as outreach opportunities with the private sector.
